Shri Harish Sharma - Dy. Govt. Advocate for the respo

Order
1.
The applicant has filed this second repeat application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail.

The applicant has been arrested on 15.03.2024 by Police Station Badarbas, District Shivpuri in connection with Crime No.72/2024 for the offences punishable under Sections 363, 376 of IPC and Section 3/4 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
First bail application was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 20.06.2024 passed in M.Cr.C. No.19752/2024 with liberty to the applicant to repeat after the statement of the prosecutrix in the trial.
2.
It is the submission of counsel for the applicant that he is suffering confinement since 15.03.2024 and suffered almost more than seven months' incarceration.
Charge-sheet has already been filed.
Counsel referred to the Court statement of the prosecutrix to submit that it is the matter of consent and apparently she left her maternal home on her own volition.
Confinement NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-GWL:19489 2 MCRC-39656-2024 amounts to pretrial detention.
He undertakes to abide by all the terms and conditions as imposed by this Court and would not try to temper with the evidence.
Under such circumstances, learned counsel prays that applicant may be enlarged on bail.
3 . Learned counsel for the State opposed the prayer and prayed for dismissal of the application.

4. Heard learned counsel for the parties at length and perused the case diary.

sentences.text: 5. Considering the submissions advanced by the learned counsel for the parties and looking to the Court statement of prosecutrix, but without commenting on the merits of the case, this Court intends to allow this application.
Accordingly, the application is allowed.

It is hereby directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/-
(Rupees One Lac Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of trial Court concerned.
Application stands allowed and disposed of.
8. A copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance and information.
9. Certified Copy as per rules.
